entities.name: ST6GAL1
observations: ST6GAL1 encodes GALβ1-4GlcNAc α2-6-sialyltransferase (ST6GalI), the serum enzyme measured in the kidney-transplant study.

entities.name: Delayed graft function
observations: In PMID 10755530, delayed graft function was operationalized as requiring posttransplant dialysis; 20 of 70 kidney recipients met this definition.
Higher immediately pretransplant serum ST6GalI was observed in the dialysis/DGF group: 3735 ± 228 U versus 2933 ± 83 U in the non-dialysis group; P<0.0001.
Multivariable analysis reportedly identified ST6GalI level and cold ischemic time as independent risk factors for dialysis-defined DGF.
The evidence is from one 2000 cohort and lacks reported odds ratio, confidence interval, AUC, cutoff, calibration, or external validation in the accessible record.

entities.name: PMID:10755530
observations: Transplantation (2000): Increased levels of GALβ1-4GlcNAc α2-6 sialyltransferase immediately pretransplant were associated with subsequent dialysis-defined delayed graft function in 70 kidney transplant recipients.
